scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.test:migration: node scripts/test-multi-artifact.cjs && node scripts/test-dev-gateway.cjs && node scripts/test-android-native-startup.cjs && node scripts/test-chat-native-startup.cjs && node scripts/test-landing-feature-flag.cjs
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
